convert_block_tables_to_ragged: convert block tables to ragged format compatible with FlashInfer using Triton or fallback Python
convert_block_tables_to_padded: convert ragged block tables back to padded format using a Triton kernel
copy_next_input_ids_inplace: copy next input token IDs into all_input_ids tensor in-place using a Triton kernel
prepare_position_slot_ids: prepare position IDs and slot indices tensors for batched decoding using a Triton kernel
filter_slots: filter slots tensor using cumulative slot offsets and start indices via a Triton kernel
